title: Install Weekly Blitz — Jan 18 2027
body:
Purpose: quick sync for the install squad — highlight open blockers across current VPC/on-prem installs, surface risks to SRE and solutions-eng, and capture immediate action items. Informal notes: writeups, scratch items, and follow-ups for the week.

Attendees: Asha (owner), Miguel, Priya, Omar, Jae, Sophie, plus brief join from CS: Lina.

Summary (one-liner): Momentum across 3 active installs but two customer networks exhibiting intermittent path MTU and NFS stability problems; KMS onboarding delayed pending customer security review; need targeted kernel driver debug for NIC offload on Edge-2 nodes.

Active Installs & Standup Snippets

1) Acadia Health (onprem) — week 3 of install
- Current status: baseline services deployed; control plane healthy; inference nodes pass unit tests but fail long-run workloads.
- Recent symptom: long-tail token latency spikes under sustained QPS; correlated with periodic NFS IO stalls.
- Troubleshooting done: enabled NFS client debug logging; replayed workload in isolated staging with same mount options; reproduced IO flakiness when client readdir is heavy.
- Hypothesis: NFS server tuning + aggressive client caching causing kernel-level stalls under sustained directory scans.
- Next steps: Priya to propose mount option change and patch /etc/fstab during maintenance window (slated 2027-01-20 02:00 UTC). Create runbook step and rollback path.
- Blocking items: customer security needs sign-off for minor sudo change (ticket PLT-4234).

2) Stratum Retail (VPC private deploy) — day 5 of warmstart
- Current status: infra provisioning complete; internal smoke tests pass; ingress LB intermittently returns 502 for streaming endpoints.
- Observations: 502 spikes align with autoscaler cooldown windows and a rare nginx worker OOM in edge-proxy.
- Mitigation applied: lowered concurrency limit on nginx; applied temporary pod anti-affinity to spread memory pressure.
- Next steps: Omar to run memprof on failing worker and ramp instance type to 32Gi for two weeks to see if pattern changes. If stable, propose cost offset via batching config in Redwood Optimize.
- Risk/ask: inform sales that streaming SLA may be affected for next 48 hrs.

3) Meridian Finance (air-gapped onprem) — day 10
- Current status: offline repo sync completed; HSM/KMS integration started.
- Roadblock: customer's security team has flagged the HSM network policy for review; can't proceed with key import until review is done.
- Notes: Sophie built sanitized KMS documentation for their auditors and will attend customer call Friday.
- Next steps: Sophie + Jae to run a short demonstration (screen share) mapping our HSM calls to their policy controls. Targeting 2027-01-22.

Cross-Cutting Technical Items

A) NIC offload kernel panic on Edge-2 nodes
- Symptom: occasional kernel oops when hw-offload is on and multi-queue enabled. Seen on 3 different customers (non-identical kernels).
- Action: captured vmcore + dmesg; Miguel reproduced locally under stress harness and isolated to driver ixgbe 5.6.x.
- Interim: disable hw-offload via installer flag for affected node pools.
- Long-term: PR to installer to detect driver version and auto-disable offload until patched. Miguel drafting patch (GH PR linked).

B) KMS onboarding friction pattern
- Common customer ask: audit events granularity + short-lived session keys. Our private-deploy KMS sample shows event batching which fails some auditors.
- Work: created short explainer doc + minimal kernel for auditors. Sophie owns aligning with product compliance.

C) Observability gaps during installs
- Problem: when installs are air-gapped, we lose quick traces for startup failures; current guidance to ship a 48-hr observability bundle with each install is fugitive and inconsistent.
- Proposal: build a small offline trace collector that packages systemd logs, docker/containerd logs, and tracer snapshots into a single bundle. Jae will prototype.

Customer-Facing Commitments (what we told customers)
- Acadia: mount option change on 2027-01-20 02:00 UTC; full rollback steps documented.
- Stratum: temporary scaling and config changes applied; expect re-eval 2027-01-21.
- Meridian: demo of HSM mapping 2027-01-22.

Open Blockers (priority order)
- PLT-4234: Acadia security sign-off for sudo change (owner: Asha). Awaiting inbound from customer SecOps.
- Edge-2 kernel panic: need validated ixgbe driver patch or workarounds across customers (owner: Miguel).
- KMS audit detail: finalize sanitized event schema (owner: Sophie).
- Installer auto-detect for NIC offload (owner: Miguel + Jae).

Action Items (short list, owners, ETA)
- Priya: implement & test fstab mount change on Acadia staging and produce quick rollback doc (ETA 2027-01-19).
- Miguel: finish ixgbe detection/disable PR and run stress harness across kernels 5.10–5.16 (ETA 2027-01-21).
- Omar: memprof and temporary node scaling for Stratum, capture OOM traces (ETA 2027-01-20).
- Sophie: deliver sanitized HSM doc and join Friday call (ETA 2027-01-22).
- Jae: prototype offline trace-bundle tool and share PoC CLI (ETA 2027-01-25).
- Asha: escalate PLT-4234 to customer CISO liaison and provide timeline for the sudo change (ETA 2027-01-19).

Notes-to-self / Scratch
- Keep a short bank of customer-safe kernel modules to test quickly on fresh nodes.
- Consider adding a pre-install network checklist for customer-run DNS and MTU baseline. Save as template in Confluence.
- Reminder: update installer changelog with any temporary flags we bake for offload disable to avoid 'mystery flags' on customer upgrades.

Risk Table (quick)
- High: prolonged security review stalls installs (mitigate by pre-packaging auditor-friendly docs).
- Medium: repeated OOMs on streaming proxy degrade SLA (mitigate by temporary scaling + Optimize recommendations).
- Low: observability bundle missing leads to slow triage; fix with trace-bundle PoC.

Escalations and asks for SRE/Product
- SRE: need an on-call window next Tuesday for Acadia maintenance (2:00–04:00 UTC) — confirm rotation.
- Product: can we surface a rollback toggle in Console for KMS config to reassure customers during key import? (ask Product-Hosted-API).

Decisions made during call
- Agree to disable NIC offload for Edge-2 node pools until driver patch lands.
- Approve short-term scaling for Stratum (cost borne by field until stable).

Next meeting: Wednesday 2027-01-20 09:00 PST (standup + post-maintenance review).

Misc links and references (for quick copy/paste)
- Runbook skeleton: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PD/Install+Runbook+Skeleton
- Installer PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/pull/287
- Jira: PLT-4234, PLT-4278, PLT-4301

Finish: quick capture so people can read and react asynchronously. Please add any missed notes inline and mark actions done when complete.

-- Asha
